item.title: This simple, ingenious design keeps drones from breaking when they crash
item.description: ETH Zürich’s FlexiQuad uses a flexible ring fuselage to bounce off walls, squeeze through gaps, and grab objects on the fly. At first glance, FlexiQuad looks like a small drone. Just one more buzzing thingy doing its flying thing. Then you see it crashing against a tree. A regular drone would crash and fall to the ground, but this one bounces back from the tree trunk and happily keeps flying along....
